object.description: Steps: 1. Read UnitFormatter.pace in app/app/src/main/java/com/pacemark/ui/format/UnitFormatter.kt. 2. Run UnitFormatterTest 'zero or negative pace renders placeholder'. Expected: The source returns the dash placeholder for a pace of 0 s/km or less and above 3600 s/km, and formats 3600 s/km as minutes and seconds. The JUnit test proves 0 and -1 only; the 3600 s/km boundary is proven by inspection.
